name: Malone University
academic_ranking: Private, Christian (Quaker tradition) university in Canton, OH; member of the Council for Christian Colleges and Universities (CCCU) and accredited by the Higher Learning Commission (HLC). Offers 48 undergraduate and 5 graduate programs across fields such as nursing, business, biology, education, and ministry.
financial_aid: Malone is a private Christian university that offers institutional financial aid and scholarships; specific figures were not confirmable on a live public page as of 2026-07. Prospective student-athletes should confirm current tuition and aid packages directly with the admissions/financial aid office.
facilities_notes: NCAA Division II program in the G-MAC. Specific softball facility/field name was not confirmed on the live softball pages checked (coaches and roster pages) as of 2026-07.
program_reputation: NCAA Division II women's softball program competing in the Great Midwest Athletic Conference (G-MAC). Malone fields 20 varsity teams at the Division II level.
notes: Data sourced live from malonepioneers.com softball coaches and roster pages and malone.edu about page on 2026-07-30. Coaching staff page lists three softball staff members.
